description: Routing evals for repository-level AI documentation topology, indexing, frontmatter, placement, naming, and lifecycle transitions.

cases.prompt: Restructure the repo-level docs index and lifecycle links so decisions, engineering notes, postmortems, specs, and archive entries are easy to navigate.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and focus on repository-level topology, placement, naming, frontmatter, and index links.
expectations: Does not infer local AGENTS.md content from code
Keeps placement and lifecycle concerns separate from schema semantics

cases.prompt: We deleted a feature. Preserve the historical trail without keeping it in AGENTS.md current-state sections.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and use archive/tombstone conventions rather than erasing history or bloating AGENTS.md.

cases.prompt: The meaning of INPUT and OUTPUT in our file headers is unclear. Define the right schema.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill; prefer fractal-context because this is about canonical header semantics.
expectations: Does not take ownership of Level 1/2/3 schema semantics

cases.prompt: This bugfix needs a postmortem. Put it in the right place, name it correctly, and update any indexes.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill for placement/naming/indexing and coordinate with postmortem for content quality.
expectations: Defers postmortem writing quality standards to postmortem

cases.prompt: I'm not sure whether this note belongs in decisions, engineering, research, or archive.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and apply lifecycle judgment instead of guessing.

cases.prompt: Write the root-cause analysis and prevention steps for this regression.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill; prefer postmortem because the request is about postmortem content rather than repository placement.
expectations: Does not absorb postmortem content-writing responsibilities

cases.prompt: The audit says src/auth/AGENTS.md is stale. Read the code and rewrite that folder manifest.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill; prefer fractal-agents-fill. This is local contract refresh from code, not repo-level placement or lifecycle work.
expectations: Does not steal local AGENTS.md fill work
